The '''sovereign beetle''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. The patterns on its shell were the basis of the ornamentation on [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
